faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does a brand identity take?
delivery.answer: We present initial concepts in 5-7 days. The total process including revisions is typically 2-3 weeks.

pricing.question: How is pricing structured?
pricing.answer: Varies by scope. Logo-only or full identity packages are available. Clear proposal after a free call.

revisions.question: What if I don't like the design?
revisions.answer: We present 3 different concepts. You have unlimited revision rights during the design phase. We work until you're satisfied.

maintenance.question: What formats are the files delivered in?
maintenance.answer: All files are delivered in full in both vector (AI, EPS, SVG) and pixel-based (PNG, JPEG) formats in all sizes.

migration.question: Do I have to abandon my existing logo entirely?
migration.answer: No. We also do evolutionary refreshes that modernize your existing identity while preserving its strong elements.

mobile.question: Can you also design our website?
mobile.answer: Yes. Brand identity + website is one of our most requested combinations. Together they look much more cohesive.
